parsed.rationale: Likely lateral ankle sprain; able to bear weight and no deformity, numbness, or inability to walk described, so no Ottawa red flags. Manage with rest, ice, compression, elevation, OTC analgesics. Seek in-person evaluation if unable to bear weight, focal bone tenderness at malleoli/5th metatarsal base, worsening pain/swelling, or no improvement in 3-5 days.
